convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 functions (SymbolInfoDouble, AccountInfoDouble, OrderCheck, OrderSend, HistoryDealSelect). No custom indicators, no external .mqh libraries, no grid/martingale. Simple alternating buy/sell market orders with risk-based position sizing. Single position at a time.

derived_values.name: tick_size - price increment per tick for the symbol
margin_risk - dollar amount of equity risked per trade
margin_risk_1lot - risk in account currency for 1 lot at given SL distance
volume - calculated lot size based on risk
derived_values.formula: MathFloor(margin_risk / margin_risk_1lot / lot_step) * min_lot, clamped to [min_lot, max_lot]

derived_values.name: profit_expected - expected profit/loss amount based on risk percent
delta_stoploss - absolute price distance between entry and SL

params.adjustment: uses SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE not _Point, so no digit adjustment needed

other_exits: Position is closed by SL or TP only; no other exit logic. OnTradeTransaction detects DEAL_ENTRY_OUT to reset pos_open flag.

params.calculation: margin_risk / margin_risk_1lot, rounded down to lot_step increments

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Volume = floor((equity * risk% / 100) / (SL_ticks * tick_value) / lot_step) * min_lot. If zero, uses min_lot. If above max_lot, uses max_lot.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses an alternating order_type toggle (BUY↔SELL) that flips on every new entry attempt, regardless of market conditions. There are NO technical indicators or signal conditions — the EA simply alternates between buy and sell on every tick when no position is open. This is essentially a random-entry testing framework with risk-based position sizing. SL and TP are symmetric (equal distances). The EA logs expected vs actual profit on deal close via OnTradeTransaction.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. No indicators needed. Key functions to replicate: (1) Alternating buy/sell toggle with pos_open gate, (2) GetVolByRisk using tick_size/tick_value for risk-based lot calculation, (3) OnTradeTransaction equivalent for detecting position close and resetting state, (4) SL/TP set symmetrically using tick_size * stoploss_points. The tick_size-based SL/TP is broker/symbol-agnostic so no digit adjustment logic needed. Use broker's tick_size and tick_value directly from symbol info.
